name: @mercatus-liber/migrate-shopify
description: One-time Shopify-to-native migration tool (epic shopify-migration-import-tool). This is NOT @mercatus-liber/adapter-shopify, which is a live wrapper that proxies catalog reads/writes through Shopify's API forever -- this package reads a merchant's existing Shopify store exactly once and is meant to feed that data into Mercatus Liber's own native persistence, so a merchant can actually leave Shopify. This first slice is the read side only: it returns structured data and writes nothing.
